blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Senator Francis Escudero has said that he is not being biased in the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Dutert and that the proceedings ar fair. During an episode of his podcast aired on Sunday, one of the podcast hosts asked if he has no biases in the impeachment trial of Duterte. “Oo, sa simpleng dahilan, wala pa akong desisyon eh. Hindi pa ako nakakapagpasya,” Escudero, the presiding officer of the trial, replied. (Yes, for a simple reason, I don’t have a decision yet. I haven’t decided on anything.)
